snippet.title: Second Gameplay Trailer  — Five Shifts at Zlata's DEMO (FSaZ)
snippet.description:
Watch the second Gameplay Trailer RIGHT NOW!!!

Also, discover new mechanics, a new enemy, and the release date of the demo version on Steam and Itch.io.

Trailer Team:

Voice-over, Editing, Developer & Writer — Leon Oprya / MrALLAY
Face of the Game, Art Designer, Writer — Zlata Zavyalova
Art Designer, Writer, Editor — Isabella Ballirano
Sound Designer, Art Designer, Game Meme Spirit — Victoria Shpak / Grape322
Voice Actor — Daniil Kofman
